verdict.rationale: PostHog documents an official, free, hosted MCP server at https://mcp.posthog.com/mcp. It works with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, VS Code, Windsurf, Zed and other clients, installs via `npx @posthog/wizard mcp add` or the official plugin, and exposes 953 tools across 65 product categories with per-session tool scoping and a context-saving CLI mode. A live probe independently confirms the endpoint is up and OAuth-gated per the MCP authorization spec, publishing granular read/write scopes, so every element of the story is backed by both first-party docs and hands-on verification.
